claims.statement: On finite directed graphs, discrete Chebyshev quotient minimizers are characterized by active-edge subgradient circulation pairings with zero duality gap, while the discrete Aronsson equation remains withdrawn.
dependencies: Finite directed graph topology and edge weight vector w > 0.
Epigraph LP formulation of weighted Linf norm.
Fenchel-Rockafellar linear programming duality at p = infinity, q = 1.
claims.limits: Applies to finite graphs with positive weights; establishes LP duality and subgradient active-edge alignment; does not assert a discrete Aronsson PDE for arbitrary cochains.

claims.statement: For finite-dimensional density operators on support graphs of non-vanishing coherences, the phase cocycle defect lower-bounds trace-norm coherence, while real quotient norms exhibit branch-cut winding under diagonal unitaries.
dependencies: Finite-dimensional Hilbert space and density matrix rho with support graph G_rho.
Schatten-1 / operator-norm duality and 2x2 principal minor bounds.
Cycle circulation pairing and capacity normalization M_C.
Principal branch argument extraction and integer period shifts in Z^E.
claims.limits: Applies to finite-dimensional density operators and static graph cochains; distinguishes lift-dependent real quotient norms from gauge-invariant U(1) cycle holonomy; does not assert Hamiltonian dynamics.

claims.statement: On 1-dimensional finite cell complexes where C^2 = {0}, all 1-cochains are cocycles and the quotient space Q^1 = C^1 / im(d0) is isomorphic to the cohomology group H^1(G; R), identifying nonzero quotient classes with non-trivial cohomology classes.
dependencies: Cell complex coboundary sequence C^0 -> C^1 -> C^2.
Graph truncation condition C^2 = {0} and d1 = 0.
First Betti number dimension formula dim(H^1) = |E| - |V| + c.
claims.limits: Scope definition and classification; applies to 1-dimensional graph complexes; on 2-complexes, nonzero classes also contain curvature defects where d1 omega != 0.

claims.statement: For any supplied finite complex with declared degree-2 cells, exact nilpotency of the matrix product d1 d0 = 0 over Q must be verified by an admission check before degree-2 curvature inferences are admitted, holding vacuously under graph truncation C^2 = {0}.
dependencies: Supplied coboundary matrices d0 and d1 over Q.
Exact rational matrix multiplication without numerical tolerance.
Graph truncation base case where C^2 = {0} and d1 is the zero map.
claims.limits: Replaces an ungrounded presheaf flatness axiom with a finite admission check; does not assert flatness for arbitrary sheaves; refuses degree-2 inferences upon check failure.
